title: Negative findings and unknown status
content: An explicitly recorded negative finding is distinct from an unknown status. A blank allergy list in a fictional dataset does not necessarily mean an explicit statement of no allergies was supplied. Similarly, absence of a symptom in a note differs from a source reporting that the symptom was absent. The research representation retains these distinctions without filling gaps. Retrieval queries can seek documentation of negative assertions and unknown fields. This document is a synthetic explanation of representation semantics, not a claim about any patient or a rule for clinical decision making. Synthetic research evidence only. Retrieval relevance != clinical validity.
